status: Manually interpreted 2022 aerial features, named using 2025 venue map and undated official climbing map. Approximate planning geometry; not surveyed boundaries or installation permission.

points.label: Front gate / check-in
points.note: Entrance road near the red schoolhouse, interpreted from the official climbing map; exact gate hardware not resolved.

points.label: House / west camp buildings
points.note: Visible roof beside west campground; official climbing map house identity is approximate.

points.label: Main Stage
points.note: Visible large roof on the southwest edge of the main field. Both official maps place the stage beside the southern creek bend; icon positions are not survey points.

points.label: Main Stage Field
points.note: Visible open field east/northeast of the stage; event-use boundary is estimated.

points.label: Stargazer camp
points.note: Central hilltop clearing with visible loop road; organizer identifies Stargazer as the hilltop camp.

points.label: Harmony Grove
points.note: Wooded corridor along the eastern road inside the creek loop, south of the Bondfire area; occupancy and path width estimated beneath canopy.

points.label: Dreamcatcher camp
points.note: Off-road clearing across the creek east of Harmony Grove; 2025 event map and organizer descriptions establish the camp identity.

points.label: Family / quiet camp
points.note: West valley corridor around the visible campground access road, north of the house and adjacent to west creek; not the legacy south/east point.

points.label: Havanna's Lake (approx.)
points.note: Venue map lake west of Family camp. Canopy obscures shore; this is an approximate label only, not an RF water polygon.

points.label: Bondfire / north Harmony
points.note: Northern end of Harmony Grove near organizer Bondfire location and the climbing-map Harmony boulders; estimated beneath canopy.

retirementReason: No authoritative named East meadow or georeferenced individual spring locations found; removed from occupancy and radio water masks. Eastern clearings are mapped as Dreamcatcher/off-road event camp areas, not a separate invented East meadow.
